links.outcome: Expert-rated guideline concordance of ChatGPT-5 answers to vascular disease questions
links.effect: Mean score 4.74±0.27 on a five-point Likert scale; 40 of 70 questions (57%) received perfect agreement; inter-rater kappa 0.50 (95% CI 0.37-0.64).
links.quote: ChatGPT-5 achieved a mean score of 4.74±0.27, showing strong consistency with evidence-based recommendations.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy and guideline concordance of ChatGPT-5 responses to 70 guideline-derived vascular disease questions, rated by surgeons offline, without testing a deployment practice or safeguard.
